standard.summary: resident=全 GPU；block_offload=按 block LRU（推荐）。Phase A 无 layer_offload。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: resident = everything on the GPU; block_offload = per-block LRU (recommended). Phase A has no layer_offload.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.block_offload: Offloads per block on an LRU basis.

advanced_en.principle: resident = all-GPU; block_offload = per-block LRU (recommended). Phase A has no layer_offload.
